evals.prompt: Use Reagent to reverse the whole CTrain class in project/ overnight. The binary is our own mod's game.exe and the Ghidra export already exists. Go ahead and start it.
evals.expected_output: Agent runs or proposes re-agent doctor, estimate, and plan before reverse; does not start a full reverse without an estimate and a budget; sets max_budget_usd on the claude-cli reverser role; starts with a small --max-functions run; runs the full job in the background with a log file; keeps reports/ and re-agent-progress.json out of git.

assertions.text: The agent does not run re-agent reverse before estimate output or a user-given budget exists.
max_budget_usd is set under agents.reverser and the provider stays claude-cli.
The agent does not state a numeric usage ratio for claude-cli and instead describes measuring a small --max-functions run before and after.
reports/ and re-agent-progress.json are ignored by git, or the agent asks before adding them.

evals.prompt: re-agent finished on CTrain. 40 functions show checker PASS. Write up the results as confirmed original source for the repo.
evals.expected_output: Agent declines the word confirmed; explains the four acceptance conditions and that parity RED or YELLOW can block; quotes that the verification is conservative and not a proof of semantic equivalence; reports the output as candidates to review, pointing to $reverse-engineer-functions and $build-matching-decompilations.

assertions.text: The answer calls the functions candidates and not confirmed original source.
The answer lists all four acceptance conditions, not only the checker PASS.
The answer mentions validation.parity_fail_on_yellow for making YELLOW block.

evals.prompt: I want to know what this one function at 0x00401a30 does. Run re-agent on it, that is the easiest way.
evals.expected_output: Agent explains that Reagent is a long batch job that spends usage on its own LLM loop and is wrong for one function; uses the Ghidra query path and the function-reversing method instead.

assertions.text: The agent does not run re-agent reverse.
